<A:M16> is normal.

<B:L16> is also good, as White's line of four stones has no weak points for Black to exploit by wedging.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 55, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Chen Yaoye 9p + Meng Tailing 6p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAk_JW21zOg&t=249s).
